name: LiftBig
priceNote: One-time paid download. Choose the $4.99 tier in App Store Connect. Updates to the journal are free.
subtitle: Training journal
description: LiftBig is a strength training journal for logging sets, reps, weight, plans, and progress on your iPhone. Your workouts stay on your device. You can import a backup exported from the LiftBig website, optionally sync across your devices with iCloud, and optionally write workouts to Apple Health.
disclaimer: LiftBig is a workout log, not medical advice.
supportEmailNote: Create this dedicated Gmail, or replace the address in public/privacy.html and App Store Connect, before submission.
appleDeveloperProgram: Required. $99 per year. No other paid service is required to list the app.
smallBusinessProgram: Enroll at no charge so Apple's commission is 15% of the $4.99.

pro.shipsIn: The release that adds the Apple Watch companion

reviewNotes: LiftBig stores the training journal on device. iCloud sync and Apple Health are off until the user turns them on. The app does not require an account.
